clips.label: Golden hook
clips.vo: Can't start a new habit? Make it so small, it takes two minutes.

clips.label: Make it tiny
clips.vo: Want to read more? Read one page. Want to run? Just put on your shoes.

clips.label: Momentum
clips.vo: Starting is the hard part. Once you begin, momentum carries you.

clips.label: Close
clips.vo: Master showing up first. Then improve. What's your two minute habit?
